ambiguity: Either BrowserWindow or webcontents is sufficient; worker-specific multithreading is optional.
focus: Throttle failure versus app command-line workaround
rationale: The report identifies backgroundThrottling of worker-to-window message delivery and a twelve-second burst on refocus. BrowserWindow/webcontents identifies that throttle setting; multithreading is an acceptable worker-specific secondary label. app.commandLine is only an unsuccessful workaround. Neither the setting mention nor its one-line switch call provides runnable reproduction, so request a Fiddle. Earlier #50250 toggles throttling while minimized and leaves video invisible after restore, a different observed behavior.
